quotes.text: We booked OK Mountain Helicopters as a surprise for our son’s 16th birthday. I can’t say enough about the wonderful experience we had. From the first call I made to book, thanks George, until we landed after the tour, everyone was very polite and professional. Eric was an outstanding pilot. I would totally recommend this company. I will also use them in the future.

I had a great experience with OK helly! Andrew was our pilot and he did an amazing job. It was our first time on a helicopter yet he waa very warming and good at explaing. He had lots of knowledge on the aircraft and area we flew over which made the flight that much better! Deffenit 5 star service. OK helly also have the best prices In the Valley by a long shot.

Me and My husband were absolutely amazed and satisfied about our tour only regret was not getting A better package ! Excellent value for your dollar and a once in a lifetime experience ! Thank you so much OKheli! Definetly will see us again soon!
I’ve always wanted to see the beautiful Okanagan by air, and my tour with OK Heli by far exceeded what I was expecting. I had the most amazing day! Thanks!
I couldn’t have asked for a better company to help me obtain my pilot’s license! What an amazing experience.
